title: Add model snapshotter and onboarding release heuristics
author: Maya Andersson
release_notes: Introduce a serialized model snapshot artifact and automated heuristics to synthesize onboarding release notes and performance stability hints. Backward-compatible; adds migration to snapshot table and new endpoints. Recommended: run background snapshot backfill.
description:
Summary: Adds a model snapshotter service and a lightweight onboarding release heuristics engine that generates concise release note drafts and stability hints when a model is onboarded or updated. This PR introduces a serialized compact snapshot artifact, a deterministic fingerprint, DB migration for snapshot storage, an API endpoint for snapshot retrieval, CLI hooks for onboarding, and a heuristics module that emits suggested changelog entries and performance stability windows based on recent profile deltas.

Motivation: Teams onboarding new models need a reproducible artifact that captures the onboard metadata, sample perf profiles, and affinity hints. Engineering spend was frequently consumed drafting release notes and checking for regressions across minor revisions. The snapshot + heuristics aim to: reduce friction in releases, surface potential performance regressions early, and provide compact inputs for automated changelog writers.

What this PR does:
- Introduces a background model snapshotter job that runs after successful onboarding or profile recalculation. Snapshots are compact JSON LZ4 blobs containing model fingerprint, config, top-level performance metrics, and a small representative sample of evaluation prompts.
- Adds a deterministic 128-bit fingerprint implementation derived from sorted metadata and byte-level model signature to ensure idempotent snapshots across identical inputs.
- Adds a migration to create the model_snapshots table, and a small CLI command model-registry snapshot create/backfill to create snapshots for historical models.
- Implements an endpoint GET /v1/models/:id/snapshots/:snapshot_id to retrieve a snapshot artifact and a CLI helper to download and decompress.
- Implements a heuristics engine that compares the latest snapshot to baseline and emits a suggested release blurb, list of changed perf metrics (latency/p95, throughput, memory), and a recommended stability window (cooldown period) when rollouts should be staggered. Heuristics are conservative by default.
- Adds lightweight unit and integration tests for snapshot serialization, fingerprint stability, and heuristics rules.

Files changed (high level):
- migrations/20241112_create_model_snapshots_table.sql  (DB schema for snapshot storage)
- services/snapshotter/worker.go  (background job + upload flow)
- services/snapshotter/serializer.go  (compact serialization and lz4 helper)
- api/handlers/snapshots_handler.go  (snapshot retrieval endpoint)
- cli/commands/snapshot_cmd.go  (create/backfill/download helpers)
- heuristics/release_suggester.go  (rules for release text + stability windows)
- models/snapshot_model.go  (ORM mapping)
- tests/snapshot_serializer_test.go
- tests/release_suggester_test.go
- docs/onboarding/snapshots.md  (docs and migration notes)

Commits (summary):
- a1f3d2c  add migration and ORM, basic snapshot model and tests
- b7d44a1  implement serializer and CLI helpers, add integration test for lz4 roundtrip
- c21e9b0  add heuristics engine and draft release blurb templates, tests and docs
- d9f102b  address review comments and harden fingerprint generation, add snapshot backfill command

Testing and CI:
- Local unit and integration tests added for serializer and heuristics.
- CI initially failed lint for unused import in CLI, fixed in commit d9f102b.
- Full test suite passed on rerun; integration tests took 12m.
- Security scan flagged lz4 dependency transient semver mismatch; vendor pinned to vetted patch in a small vendor update.

Backward compatibility and rollout:
- Migration is additive. New table stores snapshots, no existing objects are mutated.
- Default snapshotter is off for older releases; enabled for new onboard pipelines and if the feature flag model_snapshot.enabled is true. Feature flag rollout planned to beta customers first.
- Heuristics engine is non-blocking: it emits suggested text to the onboarding flow and does not change any rollout policy without explicit user action.

Performance and cost:
- Snapshots are intentionally compact, targeted under 50 KB compressed for most models; typical store cost negligible.
- Snapshotter job is batched and scheduled to avoid bursty egress, and includes a rate limiter to protect the profiling service.

Migration and backfill notes:
- A migration creates the snapshot table. A backfill CLI command is provided to generate snapshots for historical models; we recommend running it during off-peak hours for large orgs.

Review conversation (high level):
- Diego Ruiz: Please ensure deterministic ordering when building the fingerprint and include field whitelisting for metadata. Also suggest adding an integration test that replays the serializer across multiple Go versions.
- Maya Andersson (author): Added stable sort for metadata keys and explicit whitelist, added a 2-version replay test in tests/snapshot_serializer_test.go.
- Kunal Mehta: Can heuristics be tuned per-customer? Is there a safelist for metrics to surface?
- Maya Andersson: Heuristics support per-org overrides loaded from the onboarding config; default safelist includes p50, p95, memory RSS, and throughput. Documented in docs/onboarding/snapshots.md.
- Priya Shah: Small nit on CLI UX and error messages when the DB row is missing.
- Maya Andersson: Fixed error handling and added clearer user-facing messages.
- PR approvals: Diego and Kunal approved after fixes; Priya left an approving comment on final patch.

CI checks summary:
- Lint: initial fail, fixed in d9f102b, passed on rerun
- Unit tests: pass
- Integration tests: pass
- Security scan: passed after vendor pin

Merge outcome: Squash and merge on 2024-11-15 after two approvals and green CI.

Follow ups and TODOs:
- ENG-3490: Add snapshot diff viewer in the console and a preview for suggested release blurb.
- ENG-3522: Add a noise filter for metrics that fluctuate within historical variance to avoid noisy suggestions.
- Operational: schedule snapshot backfill for orgs > 500 models, and add metrics for snapshot size distribution and creation latency.

Notes for reviewers of future changes: For any change to serializer, preserve fingerprint behavior or add migration that re-signs snapshots. The heuristics rules are intentionally conservative; any change to thresholds should be added behind a Linear ticket and documented in the heuristics test matrix.
